candidates.name: Plumefist
candidates.lore: Too heavy to fly and too proud to hide. It settles every dispute with its talons, and it looks for disputes.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Stonewing
candidates.lore: It kept watch from the chapel eaves for centuries. When the last bell fell silent, it came down.

candidates.name: Magmatoad
candidates.lore: It basks in the lava as other toads bask on stone. Its croak carries sulphur and its bite carries fire.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Foxfire
candidates.lore: Three tails, three lies, and one truth it will tell you for a price you will not like.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Dapplekin
candidates.lore: Born where the old stag fell. The forest watches over it, and takes offence on its behalf.

candidates.name: Cinderkit
candidates.lore: A fox born in the ash beds. It is warm to the touch and will not be held.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Stiltwing
candidates.lore: It stands in the reeds for hours without a breath. Whatever moves beneath the water is already chosen.

candidates.name: Dunekit
candidates.lore: Grown cats of the dunes wear the sun as armour. This one has not yet, and hides from it in the noon shade.

candidates.name: Deepclaw
candidates.lore: It has never seen the sun and hunts without needing to. In the deep galleries it smells a torch before the torch is lit.

candidates.name: Gulo
candidates.lore: Small enough to be mistaken for prey and strong enough to drive a bear off a kill. It has done both.

candidates.name: Frostyak
candidates.lore: It crosses the high passes in weather that kills men. The herds are gone; this one still walks the route alone.

candidates.name: Duskplate
candidates.lore: He kept his oath after his lord broke it, and now the oath is all that is left of him.

candidates.name: Coilblade
candidates.lore: The temple in the swamp is hers and the swamp is the temple. Every stone step is guarded, and she is the steps.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Hornmaul
candidates.lore: The maze was built around it, not for it. It knows every turn, and it is always one turn behind you.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Blackhorn
candidates.lore: The last of the wild herd, and it knows it. It charges anything that crosses the meadow, and the meadow is wide.

candidates.name: Sandsting
candidates.lore: It hides in boots and bedrolls. The sting is small; the fever it brings is not.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Palewick
candidates.lore: It was carried into the mine and came back alone. The light it gives leads only one way.

candidates.name: Grimimp
candidates.lore: The gargoyles' lesser kin, cut from the same stone. It sits in the eaves and drops on whatever passes beneath.

candidates.name: Pitjaw
candidates.lore: It digs the pit and lies beneath the floor of it. The sand slides, and whatever stood on the slope goes down to the jaws.

candidates.name: Cragram
candidates.lore: It holds the high ledge against anything that climbs. The horns have broken shields, and the mountain has never won.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Burrkin
candidates.lore: It catches on everything that passes and keeps a thread of it. None of it is worth anything and it will not put any of it down.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Briarknot
candidates.lore: The nest was left before the bramble grew around it. It keeps the eggs warm out of habit and there is nothing inside them.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Urchling
candidates.lore: The tide put it down and went away without it. It has been walking inland ever since, very slowly.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Helmcrab
candidates.lore: It chose the helmet for the fit, not the history. Something else wore it out of the sea.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Driftbone
candidates.lore: Everything the sea gave back, standing in the order it washed up. It does not go near the water.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Whelkspire
candidates.lore: It drills the shell of anything slower than itself, which is most things. It takes a whole day and it does not hurry.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Peatling
candidates.lore: Cut out of the bank and never carried away. It puts itself back every time the water takes a piece.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Turfstack
candidates.lore: Stacked to dry by somebody who meant to come back for it. It has done its own drying and it is ready to be burned.

candidates.name: Mudnewt
candidates.lore: It breathes the bog through its gills and the bog has been breathing back. It is bigger every year.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Pitchergut
candidates.lore: It drinks whatever falls in, and it has learned what falls in most. It leans toward warmth.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Withyman
candidates.lore: Woven around nothing, on purpose, by somebody. It is the one thing here that was built rather than left.

candidates.name: Quagmaw
candidates.lore: The ground opens where it walks and closes behind it. What it takes goes down further than the bog does.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Screeback
candidates.lore: The slope it came off is still missing a piece. It rebuilds itself out of whatever is underfoot.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Flintjaw
candidates.lore: Somebody knapped a tool out of its face a long time ago. The edges it has now, it made itself.

candidates.name: Platecurl
candidates.lore: It uncoils only to move and only to eat. Stone dust is most of its diet and it has worn grooves in the road.

candidates.name: Quernjaw
candidates.lore: It ground for a household that is not there. It goes on turning and it is not particular about what goes in.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Boneshale
candidates.lore: It was a shape before this was stone. The stone is the only part of it that is still here.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Rockface
candidates.lore: Somebody cut a face into it to be looked at by. Only the face moves, the rest is still a rock.

candidates.name: Snowgrouse
candidates.lore: It is white all winter and it does not know when winter ends here. It breaks cover at the last possible moment.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Snowlip
candidates.lore: It is the piece of the ridge that was about to fall. It has been about to fall for a long time now.

candidates.name: Rimebeard
candidates.lore: It grew out of one night of cold on something that was already dead. Warm breath takes pieces off it.

candidates.name: Thawborn
candidates.lore: The thaw gives back what the snow was keeping, in one piece, walking. It comes down the mountain every year.

candidates.name: Moraine
candidates.lore: The ice pushed it ahead of itself for a thousand years and then let go. It is still going in the same direction.

candidates.name: Icefall
candidates.lore: The water inside it never stopped. It is the loudest thing on the mountain and it only speaks in thaw.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Pumicekin
candidates.lore: It came out of the mountain in the air, not the ground. It weighs almost nothing and it is nearly impossible to catch.

candidates.name: Basaltkin
candidates.lore: It cooled into these shapes on its own, in straight lines, without being cut. The mountain does this and nobody knows why it is neat.

candidates.name: Ashfall
candidates.lore: It settled over everything that was there in one afternoon. The prints in it are not of anything that is still here.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Cindermask
candidates.lore: It burned and kept the shape it burned in. Pieces come off it and it does not notice.

candidates.name: Riftmaw
candidates.lore: The mountain opened here and the opening walked away. The crack in it has never closed and never widened.

candidates.name: Whitegill
candidates.lore: It has never needed eyes and it does not have them. It knows the shape of the water it is in perfectly.

candidates.name: Moonmilk
candidates.lore: It takes a print from anything that touches it and keeps it. Some of the prints on it are very small.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Sinterstep
candidates.lore: Warm water built it a step at a time on its way down. The pools on it are still the right temperature.

candidates.name: Goodguest
candidates.lore: It steps aside to let you go first, every time. Hearn said it asked politely, and he is the only one who came back up.

candidates.name: Facewall
candidates.lore: The faces come further out the longer you look at it. None of them are finished and all of them are the same one.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Thinning
candidates.lore: It is most of the way to the Quiet and it has stopped going. Standing near it is cold in a way that is not temperature.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Listener
candidates.lore: It has no face because it is not for being looked at. It leans in when you speak and it does not miss anything.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Holemaw
candidates.lore: The hole under the mountain, standing up. It is new, and the oldest here say the worst part is who it has to be.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Deeplure
candidates.lore: It has never seen the sun and does not believe in it. The light it carries is the only one it trusts.

candidates.name: Abyssroll
candidates.lore: It eats what falls and is never in a hurry. Everything reaches the bottom eventually.

candidates.name: Barbmantle
candidates.lore: It hunts by patience and takes hold with hooks. Nothing it has caught has ever been recovered.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Chamberkin
candidates.lore: Older than the reefs it drifts over, and built in rooms it has already left behind.

candidates.name: Shockdisc
candidates.lore: It lies flat under the sand and charges quietly. The water tells you when you are too close.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Cloakray
candidates.lore: It passes over like weather. The shoals go quiet long before anything sees it.

candidates.name: Driftbell
candidates.lore: It goes where the cold water goes and has no say in the matter. It glows when it is touched.

candidates.name: Ghostcuttle
candidates.lore: It changes its skin faster than you can decide what you saw. Whatever it was, it is not there now.

candidates.name: Lobefin
candidates.lore: It was old before the first coast was drawn. It has changed nothing about itself since.

candidates.name: Rockgill
candidates.lore: It is a stone until the moment it is not. Most of what steps on it never learns the difference.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Saltmariner
candidates.lore: It still walks the deck watch it was set. The ship is somewhere below and it has not been relieved.

candidates.name: Reefjaw
candidates.lore: It does not hunt so much as arrive. The reef knows the shape of it and empties.

candidates.name: Slimeknot
candidates.lore: It arrives as one thing and leaves as many. What it finishes with is clean to the bone.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Hollowgulp
candidates.lore: Almost all of it is mouth. What little is left exists to carry the mouth somewhere useful.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Cloakmantle
candidates.lore: It folds itself shut and waits out whatever is passing. It has outwaited everything so far.

candidates.name: Lurecaller
candidates.lore: The song is not for you. You are only what answered it, and it does not stop for that.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Stonemoray
candidates.lore: It holds one hole in the reef and has never needed another. The reef has grown around it.

candidates.name: Shieldcrab
candidates.lore: It has walked the same shallows since before the shore had a name. It has not been improved on.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Clamjaw
candidates.lore: It closes on whatever reaches inside and has nowhere else to be. It can wait longer than you can.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Mudhopper
candidates.lore: It left the water on purpose and comes back only when it has to. It watches the tide like a debt.

candidates.name: Bluecleaver
candidates.lore: One claw is for breaking and one is for cutting. It has never been observed using the wrong one.

candidates.name: Kelpwader
candidates.lore: It gathers what the tide leaves and stands it upright. Some of what it gathers used to walk.

candidates.name: Hushwing

candidates.name: Prismtail
candidates.lore: It is the loudest thing in the meadow and the hardest to see. Both are on purpose.

candidates.name: Redcrest
candidates.lore: It repeats what it hears in the voice it heard it in. People have learned to be careful near it.

candidates.name: Bladefoot
candidates.lore: It asks for nothing and gives no warning. The claw does the only talking it needs.

candidates.name: Mirecrane
candidates.lore: It stands in the shallows until it is part of them, then strikes once without bending.

candidates.name: Gallowcrow
candidates.lore: It keeps count of the fields it visits and comes back in the right order. Nobody taught it that.

candidates.name: Rimefowl
candidates.lore: It vanishes by standing still. In summer it is a different bird and knows it.

candidates.name: Reedstalker
candidates.lore: It becomes a reed when watched and a bird when not. It is patient enough for both.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Duskhang
candidates.lore: It hangs where the orchard ends and takes its share first. It has never been caught taking twice.

candidates.name: Bloodwing
candidates.lore: It takes a little from many and is gone before morning. The herd wakes up merely tired.

candidates.name: Jewelback
candidates.lore: The jaws are for other beetles, not for you. It will still close them on a finger.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Bonepicker
candidates.lore: It finds the dead before the crows do and buries them where only it can find them again.

candidates.name: Duskmoth
candidates.lore: It is drawn to lit windows and cannot explain why. It has never harmed the lamp or itself.

candidates.name: Twigcase
candidates.lore: It builds its house from the riverbed and carries it. Everything it owns is glued on.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Glassnymph
candidates.lore: It spends a year under a stone for one evening in the air. It does not seem to mind the trade.

candidates.name: Coalback
candidates.lore: It nests in the warm rock and takes the heat with it when it leaves. The nest cools within hours.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Scalewader
candidates.lore: It holds the shallows the way a border is held. It has never once come further up the beach.

candidates.name: Bluecoil
candidates.lore: It comes ashore only to rest and has no interest in anything it cannot swallow whole.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Slagsmith
candidates.lore: It smelts whatever is brought to it and asks no questions about where the metal came from.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Bellowsback
candidates.lore: It was built to keep a fire and has kept one since. Nobody living remembers lighting it.

south-west: content touches the canvas edge (clipped)

candidates.name: Brushkit
candidates.lore: Too young to hunt well and too proud to admit it. It follows the older ones at a careful distance.

candidates.name: Digclaw
candidates.lore: It gives ground to nothing and has the scars to prove the policy works.

candidates.name: Tuftear
candidates.lore: It crosses deep snow without sinking and arrives where nothing was watching.

candidates.name: Scytharm
candidates.lore: It holds its arms as if praying and has never once been mistaken for harmless twice.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Elderscute
candidates.lore: It has outlived the forest twice and shows no sign of having noticed either time.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Meadowcoil
candidates.lore: It would rather leave than bite and plays dead when leaving is not an option.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Whiskerjaw
candidates.lore: It lives where the river is darkest and takes whatever the current brings it, whole.

candidates.name: Leatherdead
candidates.lore: The bog kept it exactly as it was left. It has come back with the same intentions.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Bellowfrog
candidates.lore: Its call carries across the whole fen and stops every other sound in it.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Mireshrew
candidates.lore: It must eat almost constantly or die, which explains the temper on something that small.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Bogcoil
candidates.lore: It takes one meal a season and spends the rest of the year digesting it in the same spot.

candidates.name: Marshlight
candidates.lore: It leads travellers off the path with a light that looks like a window. It never looks back.

candidates.name: Mudpiper
candidates.lore: It runs the tideline all day reading it like a page and never looks up at what is watching.

candidates.name: Silteel
candidates.lore: It breathes air when the pool dries and crosses mud to find the next one.

candidates.name: Denmother
candidates.lore: The cave is hers and always has been. Everything else in it is a guest or a meal.

candidates.name: Palegill
candidates.lore: It has never needed light and does not register it. The dark is simply where things are.

candidates.name: Stonehop
candidates.lore: It jumps before it knows what startled it and lands somewhere it has never been.

candidates.name: Grubsnout
candidates.lore: It reads the whole field through its nose and has never once seen the sky.

candidates.name: Stonecoil
candidates.lore: It lies on the sun-warmed rock all day to pay for one night of hunting.

candidates.name: Palehand
candidates.lore: It has lived so long without light that it now hunts by the sound of breathing.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Stonecreep
candidates.lore: It comes out of the crack in the wall in one motion, as if the wall had decided something.

candidates.name: Boreworm
candidates.lore: It makes the tunnels everything else lives in. It does not know they are there.

candidates.name: Palefin
candidates.lore: It maps the pool by pressure alone and knows the shape of every stone in it.

candidates.name: Driftcat
candidates.lore: It follows the herds up the passes and is never seen until it has already chosen.

candidates.name: Whitebrush
candidates.lore: It follows the big hunters at a distance and lives on what they leave behind.

candidates.name: Shaggyhorn
candidates.lore: It stands into the storm rather than turn from it, and the storm gets tired first.

candidates.name: Glacierworm
candidates.lore: It moves through solid ice the way others move through water, and leaves the hole behind it.

candidates.name: Tuskdrift
candidates.lore: It owns the floe it is lying on and settles the question with its face.

candidates.name: Floepup
candidates.lore: It waits where it was left and calls at intervals. The calling carries a long way.

candidates.name: Rimemoth
candidates.lore: It flies in weather that grounds everything else, and only after dark.

candidates.name: Hoarfisher
candidates.lore: It still works the hole it cut and will share the catch. Nobody has ever accepted.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Snowvole
candidates.lore: It tunnels under the snow all winter and comes up only where it means to.

candidates.name: Palegiant
candidates.lore: It comes down with the worst weather and goes back up when the weather does.

candidates.name: Slagcrab

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Glassting
candidates.lore: Every plate on it came out of the same flow. It has never left the rock it cooled on.

candidates.name: Cinderbore
candidates.lore: It eats the hot rock and leaves the cold. The tunnels it abandons are safe, eventually.

candidates.name: Cellarrat
candidates.lore: It knows every gap in the floor and which one the cat cannot follow it into.

candidates.name: Raftercreep
candidates.lore: It has lived in the same corner for years and considers the room an arrangement it allows.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Sootwraith
candidates.lore: It comes down the flue when the fire is left to die and stands where the warmth was.

graduation.blocking: not fully approved: walk, angry, attack, die

candidates.name: Silverdart
candidates.lore: It lives in the dark behind the skirting and is gone the instant a lamp is lit.
